original_calibration.angular_frequency_convention: input/output f*a/c is cyclic; temporal Omega=2*pi*drive_frequency
original_calibration.prediction_scope: Weak single-mode Mathieu scale only; not fit to dynamic trace and not a complete open Floquet result

callback_microcheck.interpretation: One-argument callback is invoked once after final time step; it is not called again for finish. Terminal material change has no subsequent Maxwell update.

limits: Derivative step convergence not yet tested
Near-zero fitted decay not a finite physical Q
Material timing follows previously verified uniform epsilon(t+dt) convention at stride1

callback_timing_review.normal_callback_order: step callback occurs before native fields.step
callback_timing_review.held_update_sample: t+(stride+1)*dt/2 covers upcoming material evaluations t+dt through t+stride*dt
callback_timing_review.terminal_extra_step_callback: one additional step callback after stopping condition; no subsequent Maxwell step
callback_timing_review.finish_callback: one-argument callback is not called for finish
callback_timing_review.sampling_note: Use measured actual time, since round_time/stop comparisons may take one additional Maxwell step; duplicate terminal samples are filtered in dynamic runner

observable: Square root of one-cycle mean of sum |Hx,Hy,Hz|^2 over three physical probes; not a spatial H norm
numerical_errorbars: Displayed slope ranges are fitting-window variation, not confidence intervals or spatial convergence bounds
scope: Source-free late exponential fit within finite samples and explicit material update scheme
